title: BPW-2026-0483
text:
[JOINT REPORT(S)]
BPW-2026-0483
BOE + BOS + BCA
CD 11
REQUEST FOR QUALIFICATIONS (RFQ) – CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT (CIP) 2528 - HYPERION WATER RECLAMATION PLANT (HWRP) BATTERY B DIGESTER DEMOLITION PROJECT
Recommending the Board:
AUTHORIZE the Director and General Manager of the Bureau of Sanitation (BOS) to request the City Engineer to issue and advertise the transmitted RFQ to establish a pre-qualified list of contractors for the CIP 2528 HWRP Battery B Digester Demolition Project;
AUTHORIZE staff from the Bureau of Engineering and BOS to evaluate and pre-qualify the respondents based upon the requirements and procedures set forth in the RFQ; and
DIRECT the City Engineer and BOS to report back to the Board with the proposed selected contractors permitted to participate in the Request for Bids for the Project and recommendations on executing the negotiated contracts.
(W.O.: SZH12318)
summary: Authorization for Request for Qualifications for Hyperion Water Reclamation Plant Battery B Digester Demolition Project.

locations.text: Hyperion Water Reclamation Plant, Los Angeles, CA
